name: In Service of Zephras

aliases: what happens in service of zephras
faq.answer: The High Order sends an emissary to Valennia Stormfist to pledge support for Valanaar. It had tried to avoid direct violence with the Al'Aketh, but hostility and reports of large troop movements across the island forced a change. The offer brings the High Order into Valanaar's defense and carries news of Belathaan's death.
faq.q: What is the quest In Service of Zephras about?

faq.answer: Valennia Stormfist leads defensive efforts against the Al'Aketh in Valanaar. She receives the High Order's offer of mutual aid. Belathaan, her cousin and a servant of Zephras, has died, and Valennia vows vengeance against those threatening her people.

Belathaan was Valennia Stormfist's cousin and a devoted servant of Zephras. His death came before the emissary brought word of it to Valennia. The news deepens the conflict's personal cost and strengthens her vow to avenge him.

The Al'Aketh is a hostile cult active on the island. Its hostile acts and troop movements threaten the people of Zephras. The High Order's effort to avoid direct conflict has given way to an armed alliance against the cult.

aliases: why is the high order fighting
faq.answer: The High Order first sought to avoid direct war with the Al'Aketh. Their hostile actions and reports of large troop movements convinced its leaders to act. The High Order now sends a courier to Valennia Stormfist, pledging its full strength to Valanaar's resistance.
faq.q: What is the High Order's role in this conflict?

faq.answer: Zephras is the island, also called Zephras Isle, that the High Order, Valanaar, and its defenders seek to protect. The Al'Aketh's growing movements threaten its people, and Belathaan is remembered as a faithful servant of Zephras. Their safety is why the High Order joins the defense.

sections.body: The High Order once tried to avoid open conflict with the secretive Al'Aketh cult. Reports of large troop movements and clear hostility have ended that effort. The cultists are mobilizing, and every settlement on the island faces a threat to its peace and safety. So the High Order has chosen to act. It sends an emissary to join with local defenders before the Al'Aketh strike.
sections.title: The Gathering Threat

sections.body: Valennia Stormfist receives the High Order's offer of unconditional aid for Valanaar's resistance against the Al'Aketh. Together, the two sides can form a united defense and prepare joint military efforts across the region. The emissary also brings word of Belathaan's death. Valennia's cousin was a devoted servant of Zephras. She mourns him and vows vengeance, then turns to preparations for the campaign ahead.
sections.title: Alliance with Valanaar

summary: The High Order now offers Valanaar its full military and diplomatic support against the Al'Aketh cult. Hostile movements across the island have ended its policy of avoiding direct confrontation.
attribution: In-game quest text: In Service of Zephras
